about: Gravenhurst is a town at the southern gateway to Muskoka, Ontario, on Lake Muskoka and Gull Lake. Steamship heritage, a waterfront downtown, and a role as the first major Muskoka stop north of the GTA define the cottage-country community. About 13,000 people live in Gravenhurst.
seoSummary: Southern Muskoka town on Lake Muskoka—steamship heritage and cottage-country gateway north of the GTA.
